title: This Month's figure and trend line both include today's sales
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission, including Reports).
  2. You are in a location (workplace) where nobody else creates an invoice or a credit memo while you run the case, and where no shop supplies are added (for example ZZAUTOTEST Dashboard Quiet).
  3. You use a desktop browser at 100% zoom on a screen at least 1024 pixels wide (any ordinary laptop or desktop monitor).
  4. You have written down the Revenue headline on This Month (e.g. $2,422.00) before the invoice below is created.
  5. Then one invoice dated today is created in that location, with no discount, with clocked time, for example 2.50 hours at $100.00 an hour = $250.00.

Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
  • For 2: to change location, click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list; pick ZZAUTOTEST Dashboard Quiet (it charges 0 % shop supplies). If you cannot be sure nobody else invoices there while you run the case, write that in the result comment.
  • For 4: Dashboard > Revenue tile on This Month.
  • For 5: Customers > New Customer > Name > Save (for example ZZAUTOTEST Dash Customer); Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and an Asset (Add beside either if needed) > Save (if a Confirmation says the customer is over their credit limit, click Create); the New Line window opens: What Are You Doing? (any text), Add Technician = Tech ShopView, Labor Rate = EVR Travel to EVO ($100 an hour), Estimated Time 2.5 and Tech Time 2.5, tick Line Approved > Save & Close; then the Service Advisor is filled in with your name (Admin ShopView); to use another advisor change Service Advisor in the work order's left panel; clock time as the technician: in a second browser or a private window, on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Tech (this signs you in as Tech ShopView, a technician at Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 with Time Clock on); open the work order > on the line's Labor row click Start; when done click Stop > Clock Out; to make the time exact, as Admin: the three dots at the top right of the Lines tab > Timesheets (n) > edit the record's start and end (if it cannot be edited there or in Reports > Timesheet Activities, keep the real time and use the hours Timesheet Activities shows); on the line click Story (Add tech story for this line) > type a short story > Update; click Complete (if a Missing Details window asks for Mileage, enter one > Complete All Lines); click Mark Reviewed; Finance tab > Create Invoice; close the New Customer Payment window without paying (do not send or pay the invoice).
custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top bar.
  2. Read the Revenue headline (pill on This Month).
  3. Look at the right-hand end of the Revenue trend line, where the line ends in a dot.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The Revenue headline has gone up by exactly the invoice's $250.00 (e.g. $2,422.00 + $250.00 = $2,672.00), so the This Month figure runs from the 1st of the month up to today.
  • The trend line ends at today: its last point (the dot at the right-hand end) has risen compared with before the invoice, so the same partial window, 1st of the month to today, is shown by the line as by the headline. Exact point values cannot be read off the small trend line by hand; pass or fail on the rise you can see.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9579 (Story 7, Per-Tile Date Ranges); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 7. Split out of C88618 so each case checks one thing. Design canvas (claude.ai/artifact/Wae9DFQ8PJQBy8mbLsL5ge, screenshots of the SV-8311 build captured 2026-09-28) board 01_Opens_After, used for on-screen labels only.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)
